analysis.title: ECB: Holding steady until December
key_insights: The ECB left rates unchanged on Thursday Oct 29, 2026 as expected, with the deposit rate at 2.50%, and kept the door open to another hike in December.

New ECB staff estimates say higher bond yields could cumulatively cut growth by 1 percentage point and inflation by 0.9 percentage points in 2027-28 versus the September baseline. Tighter financing conditions already act as a brake, but this does not rule out further hikes.

Lagarde said the ECB has tools to address disorderly market moves that threaten monetary policy transmission, but named no instrument and did not say intervention was being considered. Investors were disappointed and the OAT-Bund spread widened.
Lagarde announced she intends to step down in February 2027, adding institutional uncertainty.
EUR yields fell after the decision on a more accommodative tone toward the energy shock's growth impact. The 2-year Schatz fell 6bp to 3.08% and the 2s10s EUR swap curve steepened to 9bp.
Markets scaled back tightening expectations: 64bp of hikes priced by September 2027, down from 74bp the previous day.
France underperformed: the 10-year OAT-Bund spread widened to 156bp and the BTP-Bund spread to 114bp, erasing earlier narrowing.
The DXY fell 0.23% to 101.96 and EUR/USD closed at 1.1162. GBP/USD rose 0.30% to 1.3365, the best G10 performer of the session.
Credit: iTraxx Main fell 0.8bp and iTraxx Xover 3bp, CDX IG was stable, and US tech CDS generally widened. European airlines tightened, with Lufthansa and British Airways down 5bp.
US PCE was broadly in line: headline 3.6% y/y (0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (0.3% m/m). Income rose 0.2%, spending 0.5%, and the savings rate fell to 3.8%.
France Q3 GDP contracted 0.1% on political and fiscal uncertainty, with consumer confidence at a 13-year low.
Belgium Q3 GDP grew 0.3% q/q (flash) and October inflation was 5.26% y/y, up from 4.69%, on energy prices. Core eased to 2.8% from 3%.
Amazon Q3 missed: revenue $201.9bn (+12% y/y) vs consensus $202.3bn, adjusted EPS $1.89 vs $1.97 est. AWS grew 39% y/y. Shares fell 5.3% after hours.
Marvell is reportedly in advanced talks to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal. Marvell fell 13.2% and Lumentum rose 0.6%. Financing, dilution, Chinese approval and Nvidia's position are the risks.
DoorDash is acquiring Instacart for about $17bn.
MONTE investors rejected the CEO's plan to bid for Banco BPM and Banca Generali, with about 91% voting against. This is seen as a step toward Intesa Sanpaolo's takeover of MONTE.

market_movers.rationale: Q3 revenue and adjusted EPS missed consensus, advertising growth was the slowest since 2020, and trailing 12-month free cash flow was -$42.4bn. Shares fell 5.3% after hours.
Reported advanced talks to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal. Only $4bn of cash implies significant dilution, and the shares fell 13.2%.
Lumentum rose 0.6% on reports of a Marvell takeover approach. Terms are undisclosed and neither company has confirmed.

earnings_insights: Amazon Q3-26 reported: revenue $201.9bn (+12% y/y) vs consensus est $202.3bn. Adjusted EPS $1.89 reported vs Street est $1.97. AWS +39% y/y, online sales +2% to $68.5bn.
Amazon Q4 sales guidance $240-247bn vs consensus est $244.5bn. FY-26 capex outlook maintained at about $220bn.
SocGen Q3 2026 reported: revenue €7.2bn (+8% y/y), net income €1.9bn (+24%), a revenue-driven beat.
ING Q3 2026 reported: a miss on revenues, costs, cost of risk and net income versus expectations. CET1 13.3%, slightly ahead of consensus.
BBVA Q3 2026 reported: net income €3.0bn (+19% y/y), in line with consensus. CET1 12.2% missed expectations.
Eutelsat Q1 2026-27 reported: revenue €286mn, down 0.9% like-for-like. LEO revenue +30.1%, video -17.8%.
Naturgy 9M-26 reported: EBITDA €4.38bn (+4% y/y). FY26 EBITDA guidance raised to €5.6bn from €5.5bn.
TotalEnergies 9M-26 reported: net adjusted operating income $22.88bn (+65% y/y). Buybacks of $2.5bn announced for Q4-26 and Q1-27.
Repsol 9M-26 reported: adjusted net income €5.42bn, almost tripled. Third buyback of €950m announced.
Renault Q3 reported: revenue €12bn (+1.5% y/y), slightly better than expected. FY2026 guidance reaffirmed and the shares rose 7%.
L3Harris Q3 2026 reported: revenue $6.06bn (+7.1%), net income $632m (+37%), orders $19.3bn, record backlog $53.2bn.
Volkswagen confirmed full-year forecasts after results in line with expectations following last month's profit warning.

tension_points.bull_case: Energy-driven inflation keeps upside risks alive, and the ECB left the door open to another hike in December.
tension_points.bear_case: ECB staff estimates show higher yields cutting growth by 1 percentage point and inflation by 0.9 percentage points in 2027-28, and tighter financing conditions already act as a brake. Markets cut priced hikes to 64bp from 74bp.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Friday's euro area Q3 GDP and October inflation prints ahead of the December decision should clarify the balance between slowing growth and inflation.
